scope: STATIC ONLY, capstone over out/MAIN_c0000000.bin. No camera. Static reading has misled this project before (the writer vtable was read 8 bytes off), so each item is [C] and needs live confirmation.
question: the target architecture hijacks one frame, compresses it asynchronously while later frames pass through natively, then hands the finished buffer to CDNG as a late frame. That needs two mechanisms nobody had located: a legal way to NOT write a frame now, and a way to submit a finished buffer later with the right file number.

the_per_frame_write_path.C037E0F8(ctx, frame): the per-frame handler. NO direct BL callers - dispatched through a function pointer.
the_per_frame_write_path.gate: ldr r2,[r4,#4]; cmp r2,#1; bne skip. frame[0x04] is the capture kind, and C1 measured kind 1 on the CinemaDNG path. A frame whose kind is not 1 does not reach the writer at all.
the_per_frame_write_path.then: C03A4C88() -> the manager singleton at 0xC359BE4C; C0699638(obj,1) -> the third argument; C03A5348(manager, frame, x).
the_per_frame_write_path.C03A5348: builds the writer object on ITS OWN STACK and initialises it from frame+0x1030, then 0xC03A5490 bl C069ADE0 writes it. So the descriptor the writer consumes lives ON THE FRAME at +0x1030; the stack node is a copy of it.
the_per_frame_write_path.after: frame[0x1104] = 0xD at submit, 0x12 later from the card layer (2026-09-28's finding).

candidate_1_a_legal_skip.what: frame[0x04] != 1 means the frame is never handed to the CinemaDNG writer.
candidate_1_a_legal_skip.why_it_looks_legal: it is the firmware's own gate, not a forged return or a zero-length node - which BUFFER_RESEARCH §8.1 explicitly forbids.
candidate_1_a_legal_skip.not_established: whether a frame skipped this way is still accounted for downstream: the state machine, the frame's own release, the file count and the completion balance were not traced. A skip that leaks a frame object or unbalances completions is not a skip.
candidate_1_a_legal_skip.why_eliminated: frame[0x04] is the capture kind, fixed when the frame is produced, and the not-kind-1 path at 0xC037E58C tests frame[0x0C] and then LOGS AN ERROR via C0011100 (file string + line 0xC45) when frame[0x128] - the header bytes - is non-zero. A CinemaDNG frame has header bytes, so forcing a kind-1 frame down that path puts it in a state that path treats as an error. The kind is a type selector, not a skip switch.

candidate_2_the_file_number_is_a_paramet.what: the per-frame filename is built from `_%06d.%s` at 0xC0B55C46, and the number is read at 0xC030AD4C from naming_obj[0x3C].
candidate_2_the_file_number_is_a_paramet.who_sets_it: 0xC030B140 stores it from a CALLER'S ARGUMENT (sp[0x14]) in C030B068(r0, r1), which also has no direct callers.
candidate_2_the_file_number_is_a_paramet.why_it_matters: the number is not a write-order counter incremented inside the writer. A late frame can in principle carry its own number, which is what makes an out-of-order compressed frame land in the right file.
candidate_2_the_file_number_is_a_paramet.ruled_out_by_inspection: the +1/-1 pairs on [r5,#0x3C] at 0xC0302458 and 0xC03026BC are list element counts - they sit immediately after doubly-linked-list splicing - not frame numbers.

what_this_changes_in_the_plan: no per-format IFD templates are needed: the design keeps each frame's OWN header and appends a new IFD, which tools/trailing_ifd.py already produces and verified on 2026-09-27. The earlier request for one sample DNG per recording format was based on a wrong reading of the architecture and is withdrawn.
the synchronous in-hook encode every existing probe performs is the wrong shape for this architecture. The hijack must return and let the pipeline run.
the node patch at the flush site is not the natural redirect point; frame+0x1030 is.
next_specific_question: find the firmware's OWN clean-abandon path for a frame: the write-error branch at 0xC03A5558 is by definition a legal 'frame not written but still accounted for', so whatever it calls is the shape a legal skip must take. Trace it and the five teardown calls that precede the 0x12 store, rather than synthesising a skip out of internal steps. Static, no camera.

manager_layout_confirmed_by_its_construc.+0x0C: byte flag, the one the write-failure branch tests
manager_layout_confirmed_by_its_construc.+0x0D: the AGGREGATION flag - independent static corroboration of the live 2026-09-24 finding that settings[0x9C] (Media Write Mode) lands here, and 0xC0378B14 shows the setter being called with settings[0x9C]

the_observer_list_is_never_populated.evidence: the manager's whole method range 0xC03A4C00..0xC03A5350 contains READS of [r0,#4] and [r0,#8] and no stores; the constructor zeroes both; and the manager pointer does not escape the module - all seven users of C03A4C88 pass it only to the manager's own methods.
the_observer_list_is_never_populated.consequence: C03A52D0 iterates two nulls and calls nothing, so the per-frame success/failure flag it carries has NO consumer on this firmware. The earlier worry - that a deliberate skip would report a failure and might abort the clip - is probably unfounded.
the_observer_list_is_never_populated.hedge: absence of a store in the range scanned. A registration compiled elsewhere with the manager arriving by some path not traced would overturn it.

candidate_3_the_skip_shape_after_two_eli.where_the_result_IS_checked: C03A5348's RETURN VALUE. The caller at 0xC037E520 stores it and does cmp/bls against 0: a zero return means nothing was written and takes the 0xC037E58C path, which logs an error when frame[0x128] (header bytes) is non-zero.
candidate_3_the_skip_shape_after_two_eli.the_skip_shape_this_leaves: do not call the real flush, return non-zero. That is the 'forged success return' BUFFER_RESEARCH §8.1 forbids - but two of the three reasons it gives are now eliminated: C069ADE0 opens, writes and closes the file itself, so not calling it creates NO file rather than an empty one; and the completion observers are empty. What remains is the third reason: a GAP in the _%06d frame numbering.
candidate_3_the_skip_shape_after_two_eli.next_question: who increments the _%06d number (naming_obj[0x3C] is set from a caller's argument at 0xC030B140), and whether a gap in the sequence is tolerated by the camera's own playback and by the clip's metadata. Static, no camera.

live_test_skip_one_frame.scope: ON THE CAMERA, authorised. FHD RAW12 verified. The probe skipped exactly one flush call - the third - and did not re-arm. Two runs.

run_1_skip_only.measured: entries 3, passed_through 2, skipped frame id 2, buffer 0x54135400, its state on the way in 0x0C, hook self-restored
run_1_skip_only.outcome: THE RECORDING TERMINATED IMMEDIATELY. The clip folder A001_151 was created (frames 0 and 1 were written), then recording stopped. The camera was fine afterwards; the next clip recorded normally.

run_2_skip_plus_write_0x12.change: the skip also wrote frame[0x1104] = 0x12, the terminal state the card layer writes, so the manager's reclaim path at 0xC03A11F0 could take the frame's buffer back
run_2_skip_plus_write_0x12.measured: entries 3, skipped frame id 38, wrote_0x12_ourselves true
run_2_skip_plus_write_0x12.outcome: IDENTICAL. The recording terminated immediately again.

what_this_establishes: the camera does NOT tolerate a writer call that produces no file: it ends the clip.
it is not a buffer leak. Writing the terminal state that releases the frame's buffer changed nothing.
it is not the flush's status: r0=r1=0 is the SUCCESS value on the aggregated path and the probe returned it.
it is not the byte count: C03A5348 computes its return before the write (header bytes plus the payload rounded to 512) so it was non-zero either way.
it is not the completion observers: manager+4 and +8 are never populated.
live_test_skip_one_frame.not_established: what does stop it. The remaining candidates are the file creation itself (C069ADE0 opens, writes and closes the file, so a skipped call creates none) and a per-frame counter or watchdog above this layer.
live_test_skip_one_frame.incidental: frame ids are a global counter across clips, not per clip: 2 in the first run and 38 in the second.
live_test_skip_one_frame.consequence_for_the_architecture: hijack-and-submit-late cannot be built on 'do not write this frame'. Every writer call has to produce a file. That points at a strict FIFO instead of a skip: each call writes the OLDEST frame still in hand - compressed if its encode has finished, otherwise that same frame uncompressed - so the order is preserved, no file is missing, no frame is duplicated, and the clip is simply delayed by the FIFO depth. No skip mechanism is needed at all.
